# Edooqoo

AI-powered ecosystem for English tutors specializing in 1-on-1 adult education.
Generates editable worksheets, interactive homework, flashcards, and live sessions.

## Canonical RAG context
- /docs/llm-context.md — full feature/architecture reference (Problem → Solution → Mechanics)
- /mem/index.md — project memory index (per-feature notes)

## Latest version
v6.9.7-patch — Demo Mode hardening + signup email clarity. Calendar slot/lesson creation now blocks INSIDE `UnifiedSlotModal` via `demoMode` prop (modal opens, save shows demo toast). `AllWorksheetsPage.handleBulkDelete` guarded. Demo data hooks (`useStudents`, `useWorksheetHistory`, `useDeletedWorksheets`) await `demoData` before resolving `loading=false`. `AuthenticatedPageShell` adds `paddingTop:36px` when demo banner is visible. `EmailConfirmationModal` and `/how-it-works` FAQ now explain the two-email flow (Supabase confirm → Edooqoo welcome from `hello@edooqoo.com`). `demoData.subscription_type` set to `'Full-Time 30'`.
v6.9.7 — IP Protection Hardening (part 1) + Welcome Email Pipeline (part 2). Prompt formatting moved to `format-worksheet-prompt` edge function; dev-only logger neutralizes `console.log`/`console.warn` in prod; demo/mock content lazy-loaded; production source maps disabled; `debugger` stripped. Branded post-signup welcome email via Resend (`hello@edooqoo.com`), fired by `auth.users` trigger `on_user_email_confirmed` (NULL → NOT NULL on `email_confirmed_at`), idempotent per recipient via `email_send_log`, internal-secret-protected `send-welcome-email` edge function.
v6.9.6 — Demo Mode Lockdown, Dashboard Compact Stats Bar, Landing mobile light-theme guard.
See `docs/llm-context.md` § v6.9.7 / § v6.9.6 for full details.

## Stack
React 18 + Vite 5 + TypeScript 5 + Tailwind 3 + shadcn/ui. Supabase (Lovable Cloud) backend with RLS. Lovable AI Gateway for generation.

## Rules for AI agents
- Never modify the worksheet generation engine prompt unless explicitly asked.
- All UI in English; planning chat with user in Polish.
- Use `src/utils/logger.ts` for logging.
- Use `APP_BASE_URL` secret in Edge Functions; never hardcode domains.
- All mutating UI handlers MUST guard `isDemoMode` before Supabase calls.
- All client logging MUST go through `src/utils/logger.ts` (`devLog`/`devWarn`).
- Worksheet prompt formatting lives in `format-worksheet-prompt` edge function — never move it back to client.
- Welcome email is sent ONLY by the DB trigger `on_user_email_confirmed`. Never invoke `send-welcome-email` from client code. `email_send_log` enforces idempotency.
- Resend sender for transactional emails is `hello@edooqoo.com` (verified). Internal endpoint secret lives in `app_internal_config.welcome_email_secret`.

## v6.9.8 (2026-05-06)

**Problem → Solution → Mechanics**

1. **Student Knowledge friction**: required category+subtype on every add → teachers skipped tool. Solution: frictionless Quick Add (textarea only) + AI auto-classify in background. Mechanics: `StudentKnowledgeQuickAddModal` simplified to text+tags. `useStudentKnowledge.addEntry` saves as `category='Notes'` then fires `supabase.functions.invoke('classify-knowledge-entry')` (Lovable AI Gateway, `google/gemini-2.5-flash`, tool-call schema). If `confidence>=0.6` patches row with category+metadata. New columns: `ai_classified`, `ai_confidence`, `archived_at`, `used_in_worksheet_id`.

2. **Welcome email CTA misaligned**: led to dashboard instead of Add Student. Solution: primary CTA = "Add your first student" → `/dashboard?action=add-student`; Dashboard auto-opens AddStudentDialog from this query. Reorder list (add Welcome Placement Test, Calendar availability). Removed "a real human reads it" line. `reply_to: 'edooqoo@gmail.com'` (admin inbox).

3. **Particles landing background**: added `tsparticles` slim build. `src/components/landing/ParticlesBackground.tsx` rendered only on anon Index page (250 particles desktop / 80 mobile, color `#643cdd`, links `#9d8af5`, hover grab, click push). Fixed `-z-10`, `pointer-events-none`.

4. **Demo /worksheet Save UUID error**: `WorksheetContent.saveWorksheetChanges` now early-returns in demo with toast.

5. **Demo students/worksheets empty**: `useStudents.loading` now `(isDemoMode && !demoData) || query.isLoading` so consumers wait for demoData.

6. **Demo Calendar UX**: `handleSlotClick` no longer guards on demo (modal opens read-only). `SlotDetailModal.handleSave` blocks with toast. `UnifiedSlotModal.handleSubmit` already guarded.

7. **Demo Dashboard Generate Worksheet**: navigation handler — guard removed. Actual generation guard remains in `useWorksheetGeneration`.

**Invariants**:
- Welcome email `from=hello@edooqoo.com`, `reply_to=edooqoo@gmail.com`. Never swap.
- Particles only when `!isRegisteredUser`. Never `particles.js` jQuery legacy.
- Quick Add saves immediately as Notes, AI classifies async; never block teacher.
- Demo navigation handlers MUST NOT guard `isDemoMode`. Modals MAY open. Save handlers MUST guard.

## v6.9.9
- Knowledge tabs: Timeline / By Skill (group by nano_skill) / For Next Lesson (shares useOneMinutePrep). Manual `archiveEntry` button on Next Lesson Ideas. AI badge on cards when ai_confidence>=0.6.
- Email footers: removed literal `hello@edooqoo.com` from Supabase confirm template and Resend welcome footer. Confirm template personalized via `{{ .Data.first_name }}`.
- ParticlesBackground accepts `interactive` prop; AuthenticatedPageShell passes `false`.
- Sanctity: worksheet engine NOT touched; `used_in_worksheet_id` only set via manual archive button.

## v6.9.10

**Problem → Solution → Mechanics**

1. **Worksheet form ignores existing learning plan**: teacher generating a worksheet for a student didn't see the previously generated `next_steps` / `phase_steps` from `useFutureTimeline` → produced ad-hoc topics, plan went unused, materials lost cohesion.
   - Solution: thin banner above Exercise Selection Cards on `WorksheetForm` showing up to 3 suggested next-step chips for the selected student. Click prefills topic/goal/additionalInfo/grammarFocus/exercises/focusMap. Empty state shows soft CTA "Open Learning Plan" → `/student/{id}?tab=progress`. Hidden when no student selected.
   - Mechanics: `src/components/WorksheetForm/NextStepsPresetBanner.tsx` consumes `useFutureTimeline({studentId, teacherId})`; presets = `[...phaseSteps, ...nextSteps].slice(0,3)` (phase-bound first). Apply path: writes setters via parent's `applyPreset`, calls `normalizeSuggestionPrefill` (single source of truth shared with DSLM prefill). Tracks origin via `sessionStorage.appliedPresetSuggestionId`; on `worksheetGenerationSuccess` event, WorksheetForm re-emits `markPresetUsed` with `{suggestionId, worksheetId}`; banner listener invokes `useSuggestion(id, worksheetId)` to flip `is_used` in `future_worksheet_suggestions`. Sanctity: zero changes to worksheet generation prompt or edge functions.

2. **Stale knowledge entries trusted as fresh**: notes in Personal/Skill Assessment/Goals older than 90 days may be obsolete (job change, mastered skill) but UI gave no signal.
   - Solution: client-side amber badge "Stale ({age}d old) — still true?" with two inline actions: `Yes, still current` (resets freshness clock via `metadata.last_confirmed_at`) and `Mark outdated` (existing `markAsOutdated`).
   - Mechanics: `StudentKnowledgeEntryCard` computes `freshnessAnchor = max(created_at, metadata.last_confirmed_at)`. New mutation `confirmCurrent(entryId)` in `useStudentKnowledge` patches `metadata.last_confirmed_at = now()`. Zero cron, zero edge function, zero schema change.

**Mental model — Knowledge ↔ Plan ↔ Worksheet** (for future agents):
```
Goals → generate-curriculum-phases (macro phases, dslm_curriculum_phases)
      → generate-timeline (concrete worksheet ideas, future_worksheet_suggestions, kinds: next_step | phase_step)
      → WorksheetForm preset chip → worksheet generation engine (UNTOUCHED prompt)
```
`generate-curriculum-phases` produces 3-6 multi-week macro phases. `generate-timeline` produces 1-3 worksheet-ready suggestions, optionally bound to a phase via `phaseId`. Both invoked from hooks (`useCurriculumPhases`, `useFutureTimeline`); their edge function source lives only in Supabase.

**Invariants v6.9.10**:
- WorksheetForm preset chips MUST use `normalizeSuggestionPrefill`. Never duplicate the media/exercise normalization.
- `applyPreset` MUST write `sessionStorage.appliedPresetSuggestionId` so the post-success dispatch can fire `markPresetUsed`.
- Stale badge is purely client-side derived. Never persist `is_stale`.
- `confirmCurrent` MUST only patch `metadata.last_confirmed_at`; never touch `created_at`.
- Sanctity: do NOT modify worksheet generation prompt, `format-worksheet-prompt`, `generate-curriculum-phases`, or `generate-timeline` edge functions.

**RAG Keywords**: next step preset, suggestion chip, learning plan banner, worksheet form preset, prefill from suggestion, future timeline preset, phase step preset, stale note badge, knowledge freshness, last confirmed at, 90 days outdated, confirm current, knowledge audit, mental model curriculum vs timeline, mark preset used.
